key_concepts: Objects can be described by observable physical properties such as shape, color, size, har
Hard objects keep their shape when pressed.
Soft objects change shape when pressed.
Shiny objects appear bright when light shines on them.
Dull objects do not appear bright when light shines on them.
Stretchable objects become longer when pulled.
Non-stretchable objects do not change length when pulled.
Some objects can be grouped into more than one property category.
Knowing the properties of materials helps in everyday life.
